G575.d: from; Of separation and cessation; of motion from a place; since; a year ago; Of origin; Noteworthy Hellenistic phrases
s: The same day went Jesus «out» of the house, and sat by the sea side.

G518.d: of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare
s: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and «told» Jesus.
We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also «tell» you the same things by mouth.
Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and «shew» John again those things which ye do hear and see:

G565.d: to go away, depart; to arrive; with mention of place or person; to go after, follow
s: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and «went» his way.
And they besought him that he would not command them to «go» out into the deep.
And he arose, and «departed» to his house.

G514.d: Part One; befitting, meet; worthy; Part Two; in good sense; in bad sense
s: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not «worthy» of me.
Bring forth therefore fruits «meet» for repentance:
And now also the axe is «laid» unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my «barns», and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

G591.d: to give up or back, restore, return; to render what is due, to pay; to sell
s: Who shall «give» account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
Who will «render» to every man according to his deeds:
And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should «pay» the debt.

G568.d: to hold back, keep off; to have in full, to have received; it is enough; to be away, distant; to abstain

s: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be «single», thy whole body shall be full of light.
And the «whole» multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
And all that believed were together, and had all «things» common;

G520.d: to lead away; prison and death
s: And when they had bound him, they «led» him «away», and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which «leadeth» unto life, and few there be that find it.
The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child «die».
And last of all the woman «died» also.
And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not «dead», but sleepeth.

G522.d: to lift off; to take away
s: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be «taken» «away» from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he «walketh» through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the «deceitfulness» of sin.
And he did not many mighty works there because of their «unbelief».
Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt «deny» me thrice.

G571.d: of things, incredible; of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving
s: He answereth him, and saith, O «faithless» generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the «unbelievers».
Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and «went» into a far country for a long time.
But first must he suffer many things, and be «rejected» of this generation.

G586.d: to tithe, pay a tenth of; to exact tithes from
s: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye «pay» «tithe» of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet «tender», and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to «meet» him.

G519.d: to strangle; to hang oneself; to choke
s: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and «hanged» «himself».

G561.d: over against; before, in the presence of; against
s: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over «against» the sepulchre.

G509.d: from above; from heaven; from the first, from the beginning; anew, again
s: This wisdom descendeth not from «above», but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the «top» to the bottom.
Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born «again».

G577.d: to throw off; to lose, let go
s: And he, «casting» «away» his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
For the Son of man is as a man taking a far «journey», who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall «meet» you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
And he will shew you a large «upper» «room» furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, «believed» not.
Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not «disobedient» unto the heavenly vision:
To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are «written» in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

G582.d: In late writers, a register, enrolment, census
s: ( And this «taxing» was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

G576.d: to step off, disembark; to issue, turn out
s: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were «gone» «out» of them, and were washing their nets.
Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods «ask» them not again.

G560.d: to hope to receive from or in return
s: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, «hoping» for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

G515.d: to deem worthy; to think fit
s: Wherefore neither thought I myself «worthy» to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
Let the elders that rule well be «counted» «worthy» of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren «received» us gladly.
And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and «press» thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

G525.d: to remove, release; to depart; to be quit of
s: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases «departed» from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

G511.d: of motion, higher; of rest, above, before
s: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up «higher»: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
But Jerusalem which is «above» is free, which is the mother of us all.
Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing «up» trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
There cometh a woman of Samaria to «draw» water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
Even so have these also now not «believed», that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a «disobedient» and gainsaying people.
For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that «obey» not the gospel of God?

G502.d: a vessel to draw with, a bucket
s: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to «draw» with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

G584.d: to bring out, show forth, exhibit; to declare, show; to prove; to proclaim to an office
s: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man «approved» of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
And Saul, yet breathing out «threatenings» and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he «threatened» not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

G564.d: uncir­cumcised; appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians
s: Ye stiffnecked and «uncircumcised» in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the «upper» coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

G503.d: to face, withstand; as nautical term, to beat up against the wind

G580.d: a throwing away; rejection; a losing; loss
s: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no «loss» of any man’s life among you, but of the ship.
Who is the image of the «invisible» God, the firstborn of every creature:
So that ye come behind in no gift; «waiting» for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the «firstfruits» of them that slept.
For God hath concluded them all in «unbelief», that he might have mercy upon all.
For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of «disobedience»:

G572.d: simplicity, sincerity; unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness
s: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the «simplicity» that is in Christ.
Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in «singleness» of heart, fearing God:
By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love «unfeigned»,
That ye would walk «worthy» of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
Salute «Apelles» approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in «demonstration» of the Spirit and of power:
Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are «absent», such will we be also in deed when we are present.
And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord «without» «distraction».

But have «renounced» the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you «unprepared», we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
For even in Thessalonica ye sent «once» and again unto my necessity.
And you, that were sometime «alienated» and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

G524.d: to despair; to become callous, reckless
s: Who being past «feeling» have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
Let no man «deceive» you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

G554.d: to strip off clothes or arms; to strip off from oneself
s: And «having» spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
Neither give heed to fables and «endless» genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

G506.d: of things, not subject to rule; unruly
s: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and «disobedient», for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
This is a faithful saying and worthy of all «acceptation».
For this is good and «acceptable» in the sight of God our Saviour;
Laying «up» in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are «unprofitable» and vain.

G541.d: of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence

s: For every one that «useth» milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
«Without» «father», without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

G578.d: to look away from all else at one object; hence, to look steadfastly

s: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men «liberally», and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be «tempted» with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being «dead» to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the «putting» «away» of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

G500.d: Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ"
s: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is «antichrist», that denieth the Father and the Son.

G592.d: (διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit), to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: Ju 19 (Cremer, 806).† (AS)
